basics.name: Jacob Lavoie
basics.label: Applied Research Scientist, Mila — Quebec AI Institute
basics.summary: Applied Research Scientist at Mila — Quebec AI Institute, working at the intersection of neuroscience and AI: model-based reinforcement learning, world models, and neuromorphic/spiking neural networks, with applications to retinal prosthetics and biomedical machine learning.
